what: Ben's Fusion check F1 made with Combine instead of an Extrude cut (35f4): Ben's 100 × 20 × 10 bar cut through by a 10 mm slot tool at x 30–40, Combine Cut, Keep tools off. Two pieces: the far one (x 40..100) keeps Body 1, the near one (x 0..30) is a new body. No face of the tool lies in a plane of the target's (35b refuses faces lying on each other until 36a), which is why the parts sit off the origin planes as they do.

recipe.do: Start a new part and delete its ready-made box (feature-1) from the timeline, as the L bracket's make does, so the counter goes on from 2.
Create Sketch on the front plane XZ (sketch x is X, sketch y is Z, its normal −Y).
Rectangle tool: click (0, 2), then (100, 12) (points 3, 4, 6, 8; lines 5, 7, 9, 10: line 5 the side z = 2, line 7, the second, the side x = 100). Nothing is before it, so nothing is pinned.
Extrude the sketch 20, not flipped (along −Y, y 0 to −20): Body 1, the bar x 0..100, y −20..0, z 2..12 (100 × 20 × 10, Ben's bar).
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.

Rectangle tool: click (30, −25), then (40, 5): the slot, past both of the bar's long sides (points and lines 13 to 20; seen along Z the bar offers its corners (0 or 100, −20 or 0) and its edges' middles (50, 0), (50, −20), (0, −10), (100, −10), none here).
Extrude the sketch 15 (z 0 to 15, past the bar's bottom z = 2 and top z = 12): Body 2, the slot tool x 30..40, y −25..5, z 0..15.
Combine: target Body 1, tool Body 2, Cut, Keep tools off (Fusion's default): the bar falls into two pieces, Body 2 is used up.

volume.why: the far piece, x 40..100: 60 × 20 × 10 = 12000. Keeps Body 1 and the id body:feature-11: 34a rule 1 (Fusion check F1): walking the bar's faces in the order they were made, its caps and the side z = 2 (line 5) are split, and the first wholly in one piece is the side x = 100 (line 7), so the far piece keeps the bar's id body:feature-11 whatever its size.

box.why: from the slot's far wall x = 40 to the bar's end

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): every crossing here is between planes at round numbers, exact, so no intersection measures past LINEAR and nothing may grow (B0 decision 5)

volume.why: the near piece, x 0..30: 30 × 20 × 10 = 6000; a new id, body:feature-22/piece:1 (34a rule 1). PREDICTED, check in Fusion: Fusion never reuses a body's number (F2: the tool's left-over piece became Body3), so a new piece after a used-up Body 2 is Body 3; ours today is positional and would say Body 2 (sticky names are a 35e/35f item).

box.why: from the bar's start to the slot's near wall x = 30

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm): every crossing here is between planes at round numbers, exact, so no intersection measures past LINEAR and nothing may grow (B0 decision 5)
